# Inter Quartile Ranges

Computes the IQR magnitude of a vector

## Usage

``` r
iqrs(x, na.rm = FALSE)
```

## Arguments

- x:

  A vector of values

- na.rm:

  Logical. If \`TRUE\`, any \`NA\` and \`NaN\`'s are removed from \`x\`
  before the median and quantiles are computed.

## Examples

``` r
iqrs(stats::rchisq(100, 2))
```
